text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Belgium to strengthen cooperation with Morocco against drug trafficking.
- Foreign media hail transparency of local council elections.
- Irregularities that tarnished polls did not favour the emergence of strong and efficient local councils.
- Moroccan team expected in Egypt on June 19 to seek ways of implementing recent accord signed during meeting of the two countries' joint high commission.
- Up to 1.5 million North African immigrants will transit via Spain from mid-June to mid-September for their summer holidays.
